The stages of an ingestion `Pipeline` are:
**Extract**, **Transform**, **Load**, and **Index**.

The **required stages** are **Extract** and **Transform** (Load and Index are optional).

[Pipeline overview](https://docs.mistral.ai/platform/ingestion/pipeline#pipeline-overview)
